observation.depicts: Dark-theme C++ source: end of a hex byte table, then the Aes256 constructor, destructor and start of an encrypt function signature.
observation.text_readable: "Aes256::Aes256(const ByteArray& key)", "m_key(ByteArray(key.size() > KEY_SIZE", "Aes256::~Aes256()", hex values like "0x54, 0x7b, 0x94, 0x32"; all text is readable at native size.
observation.composition: Portrait crop of code lines filling the whole frame. Hex table occupies the top two thirds; the constructor and functions sit below. Text is left-aligned with empty space on the right; last line is cut off at the bottom edge.
observation.tone_and_contrast: Near-black background with pale blue hex numbers, white and purple identifiers. Contrast between text and background is clear; colours are muted.
observation.sharpness_and_artifacts: Text is crisp with slight compression fringing at its edges. No overlays, cursor or watermark. Bottom line truncated mid-signature; left and top lines touch the frame edge.
observation.scan_first_read: A screenshot of code with a wall of hex numbers; reads as low-level or cryptography source.
